name: WhoReacted
description: Renders the avatars of users who reacted to a message

settings.label: Clickable avatars
settings.description: While this is enabled, clicking a reacting user's avatar will open their profile instead of adding the reaction

notes: Up to five avatars and "+N" next to each reaction's count, on messages with at most ten reactions, as upstream. Reactions are fetched one at a time, newest first, 250 ms apart, and kept up to date as people react; users NoBlockedMessages hides are left out. The setting applies at once (upstream needs a restart).
